verdict.rationale: A public API for entity records and registered-agent appointments is a fair question for an incorporation service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only dashboard and application workflows (registered agent, SAFEs, Payments activation from the Atlas Dashboard) and never mentions an Atlas API. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and llms.txt is a general Stripe documentation index, not an entity-management API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API
